reviews.comment: One pro, he is funny. Absolute terrible teacher, the only things I retained was down on X and a rubber band. Spent too much time on the same abstract idea and not how to apply theory at all (Which is what tested). Gave ungraded hmwrk, but only 20% of the test were those problem the rest was brand new complicated stuff. Quizzes are actually exams to

Dr. Kinra is one of the nicest people I have ever met. He is funny and a joy to be around. However, he is not the best professor. His main problem is that he is disorganized. This made it very hard to follow along with the curriculum.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Kinra is a very nice guy. However, he is not the best lecturer. All his lectures are pre-written and he just shows then in class. It is hard to follow through in his lectures because of that because there's not step by step process. All his test and quizzes give a lot of extra credit, so if you fail one you can make it up by getting over a 100

Dr. Kinra is very nice, however this class is weighted on very few grades. His lectures have no organization and preparing for quizzes/ exams is extremely difficult because of this. He is a genuinely nice guy, funny, and seems to care that you do well. Personally however, his style of teaching was almost impossible for me to learn with.

It seems like Dr Kinra usually teaches grad students. He very frequently glossed over things that turned out to be important, or failed miserably at explaining concepts because to him, it is simple, but to us it is rocket science. The quizzes/exams are almost impossible because the OTHER prof makes them, so Kinra's students are unprepared.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Kinra is such a fun, caring professor. He has his own "textbook" for this course that is super useful and completely free. If you go to class and prepare for exams, you'll do well. You'll also get the chance to meet an awesome professor and learn about all the memes.

It's a static's class so you have to do problems in the book to help you understand better. He was a very nice professor, he was new to the subject, so a little slow at first and very fast in the end.
